_comment: Single source of truth for ticker lifecycle status and data-quality holds. 'status' is a fact about the company: active (still reporting) or acquired (bought out / taken private / merged away, so it will never report again). 'exclude_from_active' drops a ticker from the active analysis universe at load - true for every acquired ticker, because a company frozen in 2019 does not belong in a 2026 sector benchmark, and also true for tickers held back purely for data quality. Acquired rows are NOT deleted: load with include_excluded=True to study what a company looked like in the quarters before its acquisition. Acquisition dates are from company announcements and SEC filings; 'announced' is the anchor for pre-acquisition profiling because that is when the market learns.

S.reason: Sprint merged into T-Mobile. Last report 2019-10-25. All 35 earnings dates are low-confidence estimates.
S.resolution: Retained as an acquisition profile; excluded from active analysis.

acquisition.acquirer: Nordstrom family and El Puerto de Liverpool

JWN.reason: Taken private. Last report 2025-01-24. All 56 earnings dates are low-confidence estimates.
JWN.resolution: Retained as an acquisition profile; excluded from active analysis.

acquisition.consideration: $63.00 per share in cash, or unlisted equity

SKX.reason: Acquired by 3G Capital. Last report 2025-07-25. All 58 earnings dates are low-confidence estimates.
SKX.resolution: Retained as an acquisition profile; excluded from active analysis.

acquisition.acquirer: Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, Affinity Partners

EA.reason: Largest all-cash leveraged buyout on record. Last report Q4'26 on 2026-05-05; the buyout closed 2026-08-04, so no further reports will come.
EA.resolution: Retained as an acquisition profile; excluded from active analysis.

BRK/B.reason: 10 quarters missing from the source data (Q2'17-Q3'19). Rows are treated as consecutive, so TTM and QoQ silently bridge a 2.5-year hole and Index alignment is off by 10 quarters vs every other ticker.
BRK/B.resolution: Backfill the 10 missing quarters, then set exclude_from_active=false. Do NOT relabel the Report column to close the gap - the existing labels are correct.

BABA.reason: WATCH ONLY. One suspect earnings date: rows 783-784 are 55 days apart (2026-03-19 -> 2026-05-13) where every other spacing in the file is 84-112. Financial data (EPS/Revenue/Price) is sound, so analysis is unaffected.

BK.reason: WATCH ONLY. Missing its Q2'26 row: BNY reported Q2'26 on 2026-07-15 (EPS $2.45, revenue $5.7B) but the workbook stops at Q1'26 on 2026-04-16. Not an acquisition - the 140-day gap is a data gap. The company also rebranded to BNY and the ticker may have moved from BK to BNY.
BK.resolution: Add the missing Q2'26 row and confirm the current ticker symbol.

HAIN.reason: WATCH ONLY. Not acquired - still trading on Nasdaq - but it fell out of compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule and plans a reverse split. Its 115-day reporting gap is not an acquisition signal.
HAIN.resolution: Watch for a delisting or reverse split; re-check status if it stops reporting.
